summary: Backend fully verified via pytest (24/24 passing). Frontend is broken end-to-end due to a stale REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env pointing to https://saloon-ecom.preview.emergentagent.com instead of the current preview host. ALL axios calls fail CORS, leaving the UI as a static shell with 'Uncaught runtime errors: Network Error'.

minor.issue: Cookie takes precedence over Authorization header. If a stale cookie exists, the Bearer token is ignored. Consider preferring Authorization header (or matching by role) to avoid masking a different identity.

ui_bugs.issue: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to wrong host (saloon-ecom.preview.emergentagent.com) so every API call (services, products, stylists, login, register, bookings, orders, admin) is blocked by CORS. UI shows 'Uncaught runtime errors: Network Error' overlay.

integration_issues.flow: All flows (catalog, auth, cart, booking, checkout, dashboard, admin)
integration_issues.issue: Frontend cannot reach backend due to mismatched REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

action_items: Fix frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to https://8d3f580e-9fa3-48e4-9fe2-51b4ffaf2cf8.preview.emergentagent.com (current preview host) and restart frontend (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend).
Verify backend/.env FRONTEND_URL matches the same preview host so CORS allow_origins includes it (current login-cookie response uses allow_credentials=true, so the Origin must be explicitly listed).
Re-run frontend playwright after URL fix to validate full e2e flow.
Consider preferring Authorization header over cookie in get_current_user to avoid stale-cookie masking issues during multi-account testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py (~600 lines) is monolithic - acceptable for MVP but should be split into routers (auth, catalog, bookings, orders, admin) before further growth.
Bcrypt + JWT + httpOnly cookie + Bearer dual support is correctly implemented; bcrypt hash format $2b$ confirmed via successful login.
seed_admin is idempotent and resets password if admin exists with mismatched hash - good.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout implemented (review_request mentions lockout after 5 fails - NOT present in code).
OrderIn / BookingIn lack stricter validation (e.g., date/time format, pincode regex).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Only fix REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env (and FRONTEND_URL in backend/.env if needed), restart services, then re-run UI tests for catalog, auth, booking, checkout, and /admin role gating. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses fresh requests.Session() per test to avoid cookie precedence masking Bearer tokens.
rca of the issue: Browser console: 'Access to XMLHttpRequest at https://saloon-ecom.preview.emergentagent.com/api/services from origin https://8d3f580e-...preview.emergentagent.com has been blocked by CORS policy'. Reproduction: load any page, observe network tab + red error overlay. Mitigation: align frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with the actual public preview URL the user is accessing; ensure backend FRONTEND_URL env var contains the same origin so CORS allow_origins permits it with credentials.
